options.text: Pot 1: moist, aerated soil kept in the dark.
Pot 2: moist, aerated soil kept in sunlight.
Pot 3: dry soil kept in sunlight.
Pot 4: waterlogged soil in sunlight with almost no air.

stem:
Preeti sets up pots of bean seeds. Pot 1 has moist, aerated soil in the dark. Pot 2 has moist, aerated soil in sunlight. Pot 3 has dry soil in sunlight. Pot 4 has waterlogged soil in sunlight with almost no air spaces.

In which pots should the bean seeds germinate? One or more options may be correct.

teacher.key_rationale: Bean seeds need water and air to germinate; light is not required. Dry soil and waterlogged soil lacking air should not allow germination.
